title: Item:Wish for Memories
wikitext:

Wish for Memories is an [[DDO Store]] item purchased with DDO points that you can use in addition to the [[Heart of Blood]] when performing a [[Racial Reincarnation]].

* When using a Wish, you must select a race you own on the account. Upon completion of the [[reincarnation]] you will gain a past life of the wish you used, and not the race you previously were.
* There is a Wish for each non-Iconic race. (except [[Wood Elf]])
* Note: [[Epic Reincarnation]] clears your active wish for memories. Activate the wish just before [[Racial Reincarnation]]. ({{Forums|506926}})
* Wish for [[Dhampir]] Memories will be available in the DDO Store in January 2026 for 995 Points.
